title: Lotlot de Leon reflects on how new movie '40 Days' mirrors own family’s woes

blocks.text: If there is one thing seasoned actress Lotlot de Leon realized while working on her new movie, “40 Days,” it’s that drama exists in just about every family—and that she, too, has lived through it. Lotlot has just come from a very public squabble with her brother Ian de Leon following the death of their mother, Superstar and National Artist Nora Aunor. Lotlot is the eldest among Aunor’s children with ex-partner Christopher de Leon, while Ian is the veteran stars’ biological son.
